title: VUA packages-ops result v0.2
description: Result documents for the packages-ops v0.2 write face slice A2 = install/upgrade (proposal 026 freeze batch 2026-09-19; the v0.1 A1 removal result row stays frozen and served untouched). Envelope mirrors the standing wire shape (schemaVersion/operation/result); the envelope const is the word-list-row family version 0.2 and the result document carries its own family const vua.packages-ops/v0.2 — the two versions are independent (the c914cf2 standing rule). Operation/kind lock extended to four methods: BOTH preview methods are synchronous queries and answer kind=plan exactly (their failures are wire-envelope errors, not result arms); BOTH apply methods are nine-state tasks whose terminal reflux answers kind=receipt or kind=rejected. kind=plan (changePlan): the confirmation-face projection of the port's ChangePreviewV1 — the SAME shape the A1 removal plan froze, now serving both preview faces: items may contain install rows AND remove rows on the install face (the port's add_package_request reports conflict-triggered removals as Remove changes — the port fact projected verbatim, the v0.1 changeItem closed set already carried both kinds), conflicts, removeLegacyFiles/removeLegacyFolders, destructive (true when conflicts or legacy removals exist, ADR-0006), digest (FNV-1a over the canonical item list). kind=receipt: the AUDIT receipt (change list + actual result, proposal-014 import-receipt precedent) in TWO variants with mutually exclusive key sets: the A1 removeReceipt (confirmedDigest + requestedPackageIds + removedItems) and the A2 installReceipt (confirmedDigest + requestedPackages — the request rows verbatim WITH their version-selection semantics — + appliedItems, the port's apply_install {applied: items} projected verbatim). Task correlation lives on the task surface (taskId/revision); this document is a reflux payload, not a persisted link. kind=rejected: a typed guard refusal evaluated INSIDE the task; the guard closed set stands at the A1 three values (preview_drift/package_not_found/execution_failed) — A2 adds NO fourth guard: preview-phase failures travel as wire-envelope errors (the new envelope code vua.packages.preview_failed, declared in the protocol doc) and never enter a rejected document; inside an apply task every non-drift non-not-found port refusal folds into execution_failed with the original port code inside detail as honest provenance (the A1 discipline). additionalProperties:false everywhere is the false-assertion guard: facts with no port carrier (post-install re-inspection, download byte counts, timestamps, resolution trees) are INVALID by schema, not merely discouraged.

packageId.description: The VPM package identifier (the manifest name). No tighter pattern is frozen: the word list transports facts, it does not re-litigate upstream id grammar.

version.description: Target version for installs; null for removals (port fact: Option, verbatim).

reason.description: Machine reason, e.g. transitive_dependency, conflict; null when the backend carries none (port fact: Option, verbatim — never padded; the port's install rows carry none today).

items.description: Every change the request would make (ORC-WF-002: the plan must cover every change the backend will make). On the install face this includes transitive dependency installs and conflict-triggered remove rows.

conflicts.description: Free-text machine reasons for dependency breakage the change would cause — the transparency face; the confirm UI must warn, the authoritative verdict stays server-side.

destructive.description: True when the change set contains conflicts or legacy removals (ADR-0006) — the confirm UI must warn; a false assertion is checkable against the other four faces.

digest.description: FNV-1a over the canonical item list; the applyInstall confirmedDigest binds to exactly this value. NOTE (consumer narrowing): the v0.1 and v0.2 plan shapes share the same key set — narrow by the schemaVersion literal, not by keys alone.

confirmedDigest.description: The digest the user confirmed, echoed — the audit link between the confirmation face and the executed result.

requestedPackageIds.description: The explicit request list, verbatim — the change list half of the audit receipt (the A1 removal variant; key set disjoint from installReceipt).

removedItems.description: What the backend actually removed (port apply_remove {removed: items} verbatim) — the actual-result half of the audit receipt.

confirmedDigest.description: The digest the user confirmed, echoed — the audit link between the confirmation face and the executed result.

version.description: The request's version-selection fact, verbatim: null = resolver-picked, a string = the pin.

requestedPackages.description: The explicit request rows, verbatim (version-selection semantics included) — the change list half of the audit receipt (the A2 install variant; key set disjoint from removeReceipt).

appliedItems.description: What the backend actually applied (port apply_install {applied: items} verbatim) — the actual-result half of the audit receipt. No minimum is invented: an honestly empty array transports as an empty array.
